in_marathi.name: Asheli
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Free from sorrow
in_marathi.long_meaning: Asheli हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'ashita', meaning 'free from sorrow'. This name is often used for girls in Hindu traditions.

in_bengali.name: Asheli
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Free from sorrow
in_bengali.long_meaning: Asheli একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'ashita', meaning 'free from sorrow'. This name is often used for girls in Hindu traditions.
